what: Frame rate on a Meta Quest 3S in the Quest Browser after the look pass (smoother creatures and wheels, an environment light per look, the lamp pool; a night-chase set is about 44,600 triangles a frame, was 30,500), with both hands tracked and open. Seven sets built from saved plans, no model calls, by tmp/q-perf-sets.py: median frame gap standing, and with one piece moved by code. One shader was compiled while the first set went up and none after; in the emulator none is compiled during a build or a light change, page or session (tmp/t-programs.mjs), so it is taken to be the hands, first seen then.

sets.set: night chase (real reply and its two looks)
sets.moving_sample: not used: a median frame of 3.8 ms is faster than the display can run, so frames were not being drawn to it

sets.set: funeral in the rain (14 pieces, real reply)
gas station zombies (17 made parts, real reply)
the most a plan allows (40 things, 8 made pieces of 32 parts)
